scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "pnpm --filter web dev" "uv run --directory api uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && uv run --directory api ruff check . && uv run --directory api ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && uv run --directory api pyright
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && uv run --directory api pytest
